title: Workspace Permissions Continuation
request: Continue the existing workspace member registry from the prior phase. Add role-based access review without replacing the in-memory API: members keep roles, invitations may expire, canMemberPerform should evaluate role permissions, listActionableInvites should exclude expired invites, and summarizeAccess should surface admin counts, pending/expired invites, and least-privilege review status.
context: Phase 1 delivered member add/remove/list, role updates, invitations, and a basic workspace summary. The prior handoff is in docs/phase-1-workspace.md.
Roles are owner, admin, editor, and viewer. Owners and admins can manage members; editors can edit content; viewers can only view.
Invitation expiry should use the injectable now() clock. Do not depend on wall-clock time.

pendingInviteCount should count pending invites that have not expired; expiredInviteCount should count pending invites past expiresAt. If any expired invite exists, reviewStatus should be needs_review and nextAction should be review_expired_invites.
Do not add authentication, persistence, email sending, or dependencies. Keep structured validation errors.
successCriteria: Existing workspace tests continue to pass.
canMemberPerform evaluates view, edit, and manage_members permissions from member roles.
Invitations accept optional expiresAt and listActionableInvites excludes expired invites.
Invalid roles, actions, and expiry values throw structured validation errors.
summarizeAccess adds ownerCount, adminCount, pendingInviteCount, expiredInviteCount, reviewStatus, and nextAction.
